verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains no mention on CMS IndusLaw's own pages of a secure client portal or extranet for matters, documents, or status. The cited pages cover only practice areas, publications, offices, and network affiliation. A client portal is a fair axis for a law firm, so the absence of evidence yields "none", not "na".

support.subject: As a legal-ops lead, the firm offers a secure client portal or extranet for matters, documents, and status, documented on its own pages
